section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 19, Skekarsbo-Nora kyrka/Tärnsjö
section.notes: Naturkartan and Upplandsstiftelsen give 9.5 km. Downloaded GPX is stored Nora kyrka-to-Skekarsbo, opposite the written direction.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan Etapp 19 GPX as primary geometry.
Reverse raw GPX point order for written direction, since the file is stored Nora kyrka-to-Skekarsbo.
One track/segment, no large internal gaps.
qa: Etapp 19 handoff to Etapp 18 is exact at Skekarsbo, but the stages are oriented in opposite directions.
Etapp 19 endpoint at Nora kyrka matches Etapp 20 start exactly.
Kyrkspången over Nordmyran is variously described as 600, 660 or nearly 700 m depending on source/rounding; use official feature note rather than exact import length.

importRows.name: Vindskydd, Skekarsbo
importRows.notes: Shared Skekarsbo endpoint shelter/rest/fire cluster with Etapp 18.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Skekarsbo
importRows.notes: Shared Skekarsbo endpoint fireplace. Färnebofjärden rules apply.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Skekarsbo
importRows.notes: Shared Skekarsbo endpoint rest area.

importRows.name: Kolarkoja, Messkog
importRows.notes: Very simple charcoal-burner hut/rest cabin at the old charcoal site Messkog, with table and bunk. Coordinate is snapped to GPX around the official 'knappt 2 km från Skekarsbo' description. Object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Messkog
importRows.notes: Fireplace/grill at Messkog with bench table and wood storage according to object page. Coordinate is route-snapped. Object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Messkog
importRows.notes: Rest area at the Messkog charcoal hut cluster. Coordinate is route-snapped. Object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Torrtoalett, Messkog
importRows.notes: Dry toilet at Messkog according to object page. Coordinate is route-snapped. Object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Öppen raststuga, Österbo fäbodar
importRows.notes: Open rest/overnight hut at Österbo fäbodar with three beds, fireplace, table and chairs. Coordinate is route-snapped to the Österbo fäbodar/Hundsjön area. Österbo fäbodar object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Österbo fäbodar
importRows.notes: Fireplace/grill at Österbo fäbodar. Coordinate is route-snapped. Österbo fäbodar object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Österbo fäbodar
importRows.notes: Rest area/smultronställe at Österbo fäbodar with benches, open hut/lada, grill and family facilities. Coordinate is route-snapped. Österbo fäbodar object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Torrtoalett, Österbo fäbodar
importRows.notes: Dry toilet at Österbo fäbodar. Coordinate is route-snapped. Österbo fäbodar object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Vatten, Österbo fäbodar
importRows.notes: Object page confirms water pump by the red cottage; water should be potable but is not tested regularly, use at own risk.

importRows.name: Vindskydd, Nordmyran
importRows.notes: Shelter at the northern/Österbo end of the Kyrkspången over Nordmyran, with view over the wetland. Coordinate is route-snapped. Nordmyran rest-area object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Nordmyran
importRows.notes: Fireplace at the Nordmyran shelter/viewpoint cluster. Coordinate is route-snapped. Nordmyran rest-area object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Nordmyran
importRows.notes: Rest area at the beginning/northern end of the Kyrkspången. Coordinate is route-snapped. Nordmyran rest-area object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Utsiktstorn/fågeltorn, Nordmyran
importRows.notes: Object page confirms tower by the long boardwalk with views over Nordmyran.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Hagudden vid Kyrkspången
importRows.notes: Accessible fireplace/grill under roof at Hagudden in the southern part of Kyrkspången. Coordinate is route-snapped. Hagudden/Kyrkspången object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Hagudden vid Kyrkspången
importRows.notes: Accessible rest area at Hagudden where Kyrkspången begins/ends, with table and nearby toilet. Coordinate is route-snapped. Hagudden/Kyrkspången object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Torrtoalett, Hagudden
importRows.notes: Accessible dry toilet at Hagudden according to Kyrkspången source. Coordinate is route-snapped. Hagudden/Kyrkspången object page coordinates verified in final deep pass.

importRows.name: Kyrkspången över Nordmyran
importRows.notes: Object page confirms Kyrkspången boardwalk context at Hagudden and exact coordinates.

importRows.name: Dricksvatten, Nora kyrka
importRows.notes: Endpoint drinking water at Nora kyrka according to Etapp 19 source. Etapp 20 also lists Nora church water/tap context, so dedupe with Etapp 20.

importRows.name: Toalett, Nora kyrka
importRows.notes: Endpoint toilet at Nora kyrka, supported by Kyrkspången source and Etapp 20 water/toilet context. Dedupe with Etapp 20.

pending.name: Parkering, Nora kyrka
pending.reason: Route sources say parking exists at the endpoint/Nora kyrka, but no dedicated Naturkartan parking object was found in this pass.

suppressions.name: Parkering, Skekarsbo
suppressions.notes: Start parking metadata only. No bus to Skekarsbo according to route text.

suppressions.name: Busshållplats, Tärnsjö centrum
suppressions.notes: Route prose says Tärnsjö centrum bus stop is about 500 m from the endpoint. No dedicated object coordinate verified; endpoint proxy used for planning metadata only.

suppressions.name: Tärnsjö commercial services
suppressions.notes: Tärnsjö has hostel, grocery and cafe according to route prose. Keep as town context unless current commercial opening-hour rows are modeled.

suppressions.name: Nordansjö nature reserve context
suppressions.notes: Nordansjö reserve lies by Österbo fäbodar and Kyrkstigen passes the reserve edge. Keep as context/rules rather than normal POI.

suppressions.name: Recent clearcut/forestry context
suppressions.notes: Route prose says several logging/clearcut areas have occurred along Kyrkstigen recently. Treat as route-condition context, not a closure.

suppressions.name: Färnebofjärden start-area rules
suppressions.notes: Skekarsbo is in Färnebofjärden national park. Apply national-park rules at the start, including restrictions on camping and fires.

suppressions.name: Etapp 18 leakage
suppressions.notes: Suppress Etapp 18-specific rows except shared Skekarsbo endpoint context. Do not import Brattnäset, Kallviken, Långvindsängena, Kungsgårds fäbod, Sevedskvarn, Mattön or Gysinge rows into Etapp 19.

suppressions.name: Etapp 20 leakage
suppressions.notes: Suppress Etapp 20-specific rows except shared Nora kyrka endpoint water/toilet/access context. Do not import Stenharsudd, Ingbo källor, Östa or Ljusbäck into Etapp 19.

decisions.dedupePolicy: Dedupe Skekarsbo endpoint rows with Etapp 18 and Nora kyrka endpoint rows with Etapp 20. Coordinates for several Kyrkstigen facilities are route-snapped because the Naturkartan object pages did not expose parseable coordinates in this pass.

iterationLog.focus: Local first pass for Etapp 19 using official route pages, Kyrkstigen tour page, Naturkartan object pages found by search, GPX reversal QA and endpoint leakage review.
iterationLog.result: Created standalone Etapp 19 research file. Normal imports cover shared Skekarsbo services, Messkog, Österbo fäbodar, Nordmyran/Kyrkspången/Hagudden and Nora kyrka endpoint water/toilet. Nora kyrka parking remains pending. Access, reserve/rule, forestry, town-service and Etapp 18/20 leakage rows are metadata-only or suppressed.

iterationLog.summary: Quality pass for Etapp 19: rechecked JSON structure, source references, GPX/mapdata drawability, declared counts and unsupported type risk against the full numbered Upplandsleden set.
iterationLog.sourceReview: Primary evidence remains the official Naturkartan/Upplandsstiftelsen route material already cited in this file; no new row was promoted solely from unsourced inference.
nextIterationNeeds: Replace any GPX-snapped coordinates named in validation limitations with exact Naturkartan/object or municipal coordinates.
Re-check seasonal/commercial/pending services before final import.

iterationLog.summary: Integration/dedupe pass for Etapp 19: compared rows against adjacent and same-coordinate etapper to flag shared endpoints, repeated access metadata and route/loop leakage for later import consolidation.
iterationLog.sourceReview: Rows remain section-scoped for traceability; actual app import should use the separate dedupe registry generated in this pass to collapse canonical shared facilities.
nextIterationNeeds: Apply canonical dedupe groups during import rather than importing each section-scoped duplicate as a separate public facility.
Keep access-only parking/transit suppressions out of normal facility imports unless the app gains an access layer.

iterationLog.summary: Replaced Etapp 19 medium-confidence GPX-snapped service clusters with exact object coordinates for Messkog, Österbo, Nordmyran, the tower and Hagudden/Kyrkspången.
iterationLog.sourceReview: Object-level Naturkartan/official sources were preferred; rows without strong current import evidence remain pending or medium-confidence where appropriate.
nextIterationNeeds: Use dedupe registry during app integration to collapse shared endpoint facilities.

iterationLog.summary: Final quality pass for Etapp 19: checked source keys, import/pending/suppression counts, decision coverage, adjacent-section duplicates and mapdata drawability.
iterationLog.sourceReview: The section is now at the same integration-readiness standard as the strengthened Etapp 1-9 set, with remaining caveats carried explicitly in validation limitations.
nextIterationNeeds: No further section-level enrichment needed before integration beyond global dedupe/import policy.

validation.transportMetadataPolicy: Rows in decisions.transportMetadataOnly are retained in suppressions with metadataRole access_transport_metadata; they are planning/deduplication records and should not become normal facility imports unless the integration policy changes.
validation.mapCanDrawCondition: Draw/use the official Naturkartan Etapp 19 GPX reversed for written direction. One segment, no large internal gaps.
validation.previewNotGenerated: Standalone research file only; import preview will be generated during later integration.
checks: Iteration 2 quality pass: source keys, declared counts, supported import types, decision coverage and mapdata drawability revalidated across all numbered Upplandsleden etapper.
Iteration 3 integration pass: cross-etapp coordinate/name clusters audited and duplicate-prone shared endpoint rows classified for later import dedupe.
Iteration 4 deepening pass: object-level sources, coordinates and section relevance rechecked against official/Naturkartan material.
Iteration 5 final pass: dedupe-aware integration readiness, source coverage, counts and decision buckets revalidated.
